rankings.summaryHtml: Michael Beasley and Greg Oden flashed just enough preseason potential -- though it was just one dunk in Oden's case -- to make folks worry that the champs hit home runs with their bargain signings.  Miami would have opened No. 1 anyway, but those two and a focused preseason sealed it.

rankings.summaryHtml: I know all about their warts. Fears that Blake Griffin and DeAndre Jordan can't be playoff difference-makers, even under Doc Rivers, remain rampant. rankings.summaryHtml: The good news for the Pels and their 7-1 exhibition mark: According to NBA.com's John Schumann, 14 of the 17 teams that lost fewer than two games over the past eight full preseasons (minus 2011) made the playoffs. The bad news: Two that missed out were last season's Raptors and Sixers.
